arxiv-1509-04706.title: Direct high-order edge-preserving regularization for tomographic image reconstruction
arxiv-1509-04706.creator: Daniil Kazantsev, Evgueni Ovtchinnikov, William R. B. Lionheart, Philip J. Withers, Peter D. Lee
arxiv-1509-04706.description: Abstract In this paper we present a new two-level iterative algorithm for tomographic image reconstruction. The algorithm uses a regularization technique, which we call edge-preserving Laplacian, that preserves sharp edges between objects while damping spurious oscillations in the areas where the reconstructed image is smooth.

arxiv-2104-10754.title: Wolstenholme Type Congruences and Framing of Rational 2 2 -Functions
arxiv-2104-10754.creator: L. Felipe Müller
arxiv-2104-10754.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by L. Felipe Müller. We show that the framing of 2 2 -sequences whose generating functions are rational integrate to 3 3 -sequences. To do so, we give a generalization of Wolstenholme’s Theorem. Introduction Sequences of integers (a_{n})_{n\in\mathbb{N}}\in\mathbb{Z} satisfying (1.1) \displaystyle a_{mp^{r}}\equiv a_{mp^{r-1}}\mod p^{sr}, for all m,r\in\mathbb{N} and a fixed s\in\mathbb{N} , are referred to as s -realizable sequences in [ 2 ] .

arxiv-2112-05421.title: High-throughput computational screening for bipolar magnetic semiconductors
arxiv-2112-05421.creator: Haidi Wang 1, Qingqing Feng 2, Xingxing Li 2∗ & Jinlong Yang 2∗
arxiv-2112-05421.description: Abstract Searching ferromagnetic semiconductor materials with electrically controllable spin polarization is a long-term challenge for spintronics. Bipolar magnetic semiconductors (BMS), with valence and conduction band edges fully spin-polarized in different spin directions, show great promise in this aspect because the carrier’s spin polarization direction can be easily tuned by voltage gate.

arxiv-2112-11114.title: Group Lasso Merger For Sparse Prediction With High-dimensional Categorical Data
arxiv-2112-11114.creator: Szymon Nowakowski, Piotr Pokarowski, Wojciech Rejchel
arxiv-2112-11114.description: Abstract Sparse prediction with categorical data is challenging even for a moderate number of variables, because one parameter is roughly needed to encode one category or level. The Group Lasso is a well known efficient algorithm for selection continuous or categorical variables, but all estimates related to a selected factor usually differ, so a fitted model may not be sparse.

arxiv-2203-16648.title: Predicting Winners of the Reality TV Dating Show The Bachelor Using Machine Learning Algorithms
arxiv-2203-16648.creator: Abigail J. Lee 1 2 , Grace E. Chesmore 1 3 , Kyle A. Rocha 1 4 , Amanda Farah 1 3 , Maryum Sayeed 1 5 , Justin Myles 1 6
arxiv-2203-16648.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Abigail J. Lee 1 2 , Grace E. Chesmore 1 3 , Kyle A. Rocha 1 4 , Amanda Farah 1 3 , Maryum Sayeed 1 5 , Justin Myles 1 6. The Bachelor is a reality TV dating show in which a single bachelor selects his wife from a pool of approximately 30 female contestants over eight weeks of filming (American Broadcasting Company 2002).

arxiv-2207-13382.title: Exploration and Application of AI in 6G Field
arxiv-2207-13382.creator: Renhao Xue, Jialei Tan, Yutao Shi
arxiv-2207-13382.description: Abstract The recent upsurge of diversified mobile applications, especially those supported by AI, is spurring heated discussions on the future evolution of wireless communications. While 5G is being deployed around the world, efforts from industry and academia have started to look beyond 5G and conceptualize 6G.

arxiv-2308-05228.title: Arithmetic Progressions of Integers that are Relatively Prime to their Digital Sums
arxiv-2308-05228.creator: Ryan Blau, Joshua Harrington, Sarah Lohrey, Eliel Sosis, Tony W. H. Wong
arxiv-2308-05228.description: Abstract For an integer b ≥ 2 b\geq 2 , we call a positive integer b b -anti-Niven if it is relatively prime to the sum of the digits in its base- b b representation. In this article, we investigate the maximum lengths of arithmetic progressions of b b -anti-Niven numbers. MSC: 11A63, 11B25. Keywords: Niven, anti-Niven, arithmetic progressions.

arxiv-2404-17970.title: Privacy-Preserving Aggregation for Decentralized Learning with Byzantine-Robustness
arxiv-2404-17970.creator: Ali Reza Ghavamipour, Benjamin Zi Hao Zhao, Oğuzhan Ersoy, Fatih Turkmen
arxiv-2404-17970.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ali Reza Ghavamipour, Benjamin Zi Hao Zhao, Oğuzhan Ersoy, Fatih Turkmen. Decentralized machine learning (DL) has been receiving an increasing interest recently due to the elimination of a single point of failure, present in Federated learning setting. Yet, it is threatened by the looming threat of Byzantine clients who intentionally disrupt the learning process by broadcasting arbitrary model updates to other clients, seeking to degrade the performance of the global model.

arxiv-2410-06452.title: Modeling chaotic Lorenz ODE System using Scientific Machine Learning
arxiv-2410-06452.creator: Sameera S Kashyap, Raj Abhijit Dandekar, Rajat Dandekar, Sreedath Panat
arxiv-2410-06452.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sameera S Kashyap, Raj Abhijit Dandekar, Rajat Dandekar, Sreedath Panat. In climate science, models for global warming and weather prediction face significant challenges due to the limited availability of high-quality data and the difficulty in obtaining it, making data efficiency crucial. In the past few years, Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) models have gained tremendous traction as they can be trained in a data-efficient manner, making them highly suitable for real-world climate applications.

arxiv-2504-01176.title: Covariant decomposable maps on C*-algebras and quantum dynamics
arxiv-2504-01176.creator: Krzysztof Szczygielski
arxiv-2504-01176.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Krzysztof Szczygielski. We characterize covariant positive decomposable maps between unital C*-algebras in terms of a dilation theorem, which generalizes a seminal result by H. As a case study, we provide a certain characterization of the operator sum representation of maps on 𝕄 n ​ ( ℂ ) \mathbb{M}_{n}(\mathbb{C}) , covariant with respect to the maximal commutative subgroup of U ⁡ ( n ) \mathrm{U}(n) .

arxiv-2510-21186.title: Weingarten calculus with virtual isometries
arxiv-2510-21186.creator: Benoît Collins, Sho Matsumoto
arxiv-2510-21186.description: Abstract . In this paper, we develop a novel approach to the Weingarten calculus employing the notion of virtual isometries. Traditionally, Weingarten calculus provides explicit formulas for integrating polynomial functions over compact matrix groups with respect to the Haar measure, yet faces limitations when evaluating high-degree integrals due to the non-invertibility of the associated matrices.

arxiv-2602-08444.title: Post-collision trajectory restoration for a single-track Ackerman vehicle using heuristic steering and tractive force functions
arxiv-2602-08444.creator: Samsaptak Ghosh, M. Felix Orlando, Sohom Chakrabarty
arxiv-2602-08444.description: Abstract Post-collision trajectory restoration is a safety-critical capability for autonomous vehicles, as impact-induced lateral motion and yaw transients can rapidly drive the vehicle away from the intended path. This paper proposes a structured heuristic recovery control law that jointly commands steering and tractive force for a generalized single-track Ackermann vehicle model.

pmc-11460829.title: Clinical implications of CT-detected ascites in gastric cancer: association with peritoneal metastasis and systemic inflammatory response
pmc-11460829.creator: Mengying Xu, Dan Liu, Le Wang, Shuangshuang Sun, Song Liu, Zhengyang Zhou
pmc-11460829.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic significance of computed tomography (CT) detected ascites in gastric cancer (GC) with peritoneal metastasis (PM) and investigate its association with systemic inflammatory response.MethodsThis retrospective study included 111 GCs with ascites (PM: n = 51; No PM: n = 60). Systemic inflammatory indexes, tumor markers, and the CT-assessed characteristics of ascites were collected.

pmc-11476615.title: The Role of Trace Metals in the Development and Progression of Prostate Cancer
pmc-11476615.creator: Unathi Albertinah Tshoni, Thokozani P Mbonane, Phoka C Rathebe, Jie Feng
pmc-11476615.description: Over the years, prostate cancer (PCa) research has been of great interest, and trace metals have attracted a lot of attention due to their association with prostate cancer development and progression. PCa has a complex etiology, with genetic, environmental, and lifestyle factors being implicated.

pmc-12337782.title: Th2 cell clonal expansion at diagnosis in human type 1 diabetes
pmc-12337782.creator: Aditi Narsale, Francisco Almanza, Theo Tran, Breanna Lam, David Seo, Alisa Vu, S. Alice Long, Laura Cooney, Elisavet Serti, Joanna D. Davies
pmc-12337782.description: Soon after diagnosis with type 1 diabetes (T1D), many patients experience a period of partial remission. A longer partial remission is associated with a better response to treatment, but the mechanism is not known. The frequency of CD4+CD25+ CD127hi (127-hi) cells, a cell subset with an anti-inflammatory Th2 bias, correlates positively with length of partial remission.

pmc-12565400.title: Influence and Mechanism of Azodicarbonamide Expansive Agent on the Workability, Mechanical Strength and Plastic Shrinkage of UHPC
pmc-12565400.creator: Haowen Zhan, Jing Yang, Haoran Guo, Caiqian Yang, Weigang Lu, Yuan Yao, Sukhoon Pyo
pmc-12565400.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study introduces an innovative approach to addressing the plastic shrinkage of ultra-high-performance concrete (UHPC) using an azodicarbonamide (ADC) expansive agent. The influence of ADC on the workability, mechanical properties, and plastic shrinkage of UHPC were systematically investigated. The findings reveal that the addition of ADC generates a substantial number of bubbles within the UHPC slurry, thereby reducing internal frictional resistance and cohesion of the mixture.

pmc-12630454.title: Foreperiod and Response Complexity Effects on Movement‐Related Potentials
pmc-12630454.creator: Yuta Kimura, Steven A. Hackley, Hiroaki Masaki
pmc-12630454.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study addressed a long‐standing controversy in the attention and action literature concerning whether speeding of a voluntary reaction by a neutral warning signal (WS) is due to faster, more efficient preparation and execution of the motor response. In contrast to most previous research, we found that manipulation of foreperiod duration (the interval from onset of the WS to onset of the reaction stimulus) did influence hand‐specific activity in the sensorimotor cortex, as measured with the lateralized readiness potential (LRP).

pmc-12663894.title: Preclinical Assessment of Mitochondrial-Targeted ND4 Gene Therapy for Leber Hereditary Optic Neuropathy
pmc-12663894.creator: Yingjia Dong, Zixuan Hao, Yuan Liu, Aiqin Chang, Vittorio Porciatti, Byron L. Lam, Xuemin Jin, Hong Yu
pmc-12663894.description: PurposeThe purpose of this study was to establish preclinical safety data to advance mitochondrial targeted AAV-delivered human ND4 (MTSAAV/hND4) for treatment of Leber Hereditary Optic Neuropathy (LHON).MethodsMTSAAV/hND4 was bilaterally injected into mouse eyes to evaluate potential adverse effects on visual function using serial pattern electroretinograms (PERGs) and spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT).
